## NEAREST_BY_JOIN.CROSS_JOIN_NOT_ENABLED

SQLSTATE `42604`.

~~~text
Invalid nearest-by join. Nearest-by join is implemented as a bounded cross-product internally and is therefore rejected when `spark.sql.crossJoin.enabled = false`. Set `spark.sql.crossJoin.enabled = true` to permit it, or rewrite the query without nearest-by.
~~~

~~~text

~~~

~~~text

~~~
